    "curated_guidance": [
      {
        "id": "KB-LINK",
        "faults": [
          "interface_shutdown",
          "unreachability"
        ],
        "title": "Distinguish administrative state from reachability symptoms",
        "guidance": "Compare the named interface's observed administrative state and link events. Downstream probe failures establish impact, not the physical or configuration cause by themselves.",
        "source": "https://github.com/iproute2/iproute2/blob/main/man/man8/ip-link.8.in",
        "command_ids": [
          "link_state",
          "addresses",
          "routes"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "KB-OSPF",
        "faults": [
          "ospf_loss",
          "interface_shutdown"
        ],
        "title": "Check the expected adjacency and underlying interface",
        "guidance": "Inspect FRR neighbors and interface configuration. Point-to-point uplinks require the expected neighbor. On a broadcast network a 2-Way DROther relationship may be normal; do not label every non-Full pair a fault.",
        "source": "https://docs.frrouting.org/en/stable-8.4/ospfd.html",
        "command_ids": [
          "ospf_neighbors",
          "ospf_interfaces",
          "routes"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "KB-ACL",
        "faults": [
          "acl_fault"
        ],
        "title": "Attribute a failed flow using rule matches and counter changes",
        "guidance": "Compare the actual source, destination and incoming interface against the rule. Require a positive deny-counter change over an observation interval. Existing intended policy blocks are healthy behavior.",
        "source": "https://netfilter.org/projects/nftables/manpage.html",
        "command_ids": [
          "acl_rules",
          "routes"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "KB-RATE",
        "faults": [
          "high_utilization"
        ],
        "title": "Use sustained counter deltas and effective capacity",
        "guidance": "Rates require elapsed time, usable consecutive counters and reset handling. Virtual NIC speed is not a validated bottleneck capacity. Inspect the configured shaping and repeat measurements before interpreting a high percentage.",
        "source": "https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2863",
        "command_ids": [
          "link_counters",
          "traffic_control"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "KB-MISSING",
        "faults": [
          "interface_shutdown",
          "ospf_loss",
          "acl_fault",
          "high_utilization",
          "unreachability"
        ],
        "title": "Abstain when distinguishing evidence is unavailable",
        "guidance": "A lost management path can remove several signals at once. Preserve last observations and their age. Missing, stale or contradictory critical evidence requires an inconclusive outcome and further read-only checks.",
        "source": "local:FYP Proposal.docx:5.4-5.6",
        "command_ids": [
          "link_state",
          "routes"
        ]
      }
    ],

        "faults": [
          "interface_shutdown",
          "unreachability"
        ],
        "title": "Distinguish administrative state from reachability symptoms",
        "guidance": "Compare the named interface's observed administrative state and link events. Downstream probe failures establish impact, not the physical or configuration cause by themselves.",
        "source": "https://github.com/iproute2/iproute2/blob/main/man/man8/ip-link.8.in",
        "command_ids": [
          "link_state",
          "addresses",
          "routes"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "KB-OSPF",
        "faults": [
          "ospf_loss",
          "interface_shutdown"
        ],
        "title": "Check the expected adjacency and underlying interface",
        "guidance": "Inspect FRR neighbors and interface configuration. Point-to-point uplinks require the expected neighbor. On a broadcast network a 2-Way DROther relationship may be normal; do not label every non-Full pair a fault.",
        "source": "https://docs.frrouting.org/en/stable-8.4/ospfd.html",
        "command_ids": [
          "ospf_neighbors",
          "ospf_interfaces",
          "routes"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "KB-ACL",
        "faults": [
          "acl_fault"
        ],
        "title": "Attribute a failed flow using rule matches and counter changes",
        "guidance": "Compare the actual source, destination and incoming interface against the rule. Require a positive deny-counter change over an observation interval. Existing intended policy blocks are healthy behavior.",
        "source": "https://netfilter.org/projects/nftables/manpage.html",
        "command_ids": [
          "acl_rules",
          "routes"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "KB-RATE",
        "faults": [
          "high_utilization"
        ],
        "title": "Use sustained counter deltas and effective capacity",
        "guidance": "Rates require elapsed time, usable consecutive counters and reset handling. Virtual NIC speed is not a validated bottleneck capacity. Inspect the configured shaping and repeat measurements before interpreting a high percentage.",
        "source": "https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2863",
        "command_ids": [
          "link_counters",
          "traffic_control"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "KB-MISSING",
        "faults": [
          "interface_shutdown",
          "ospf_loss",
          "acl_fault",
          "high_utilization",
          "unreachability"
        ],
        "title": "Abstain when distinguishing evidence is unavailable",
        "guidance": "A lost management path can remove several signals at once. Preserve last observations and their age. Missing, stale or contradictory critical evidence requires an inconclusive outcome and further read-only checks.",
        "source": "local:FYP Proposal.docx:5.4-5.6",
        "command_ids": [

        ]
      }

        "source": "https://github.com/iproute2/iproute2/blob/main/man/man8/ip-link.8.in",
        "command_ids": [
          "link_state",
          "addresses",
          "routes"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "KB-OSPF",
        "faults": [
          "ospf_loss",
          "interface_shutdown"
        ],
        "title": "Check the expected adjacency and underlying interface",
        "guidance": "Inspect FRR neighbors and interface configuration. Point-to-point uplinks require the expected neighbor. On a broadcast network a 2-Way DROther relationship may be normal; do not label every non-Full pair a fault.",
        "source": "https://docs.frrouting.org/en/stable-8.4/ospfd.html",
        "command_ids": [
          "ospf_neighbors",
          "ospf_interfaces",
          "routes"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "KB-ACL",
        "faults": [
          "acl_fault"
        ],
        "title": "Attribute a failed flow using rule matches and counter changes",
        "guidance": "Compare the actual source, destination and incoming interface against the rule. Require a positive deny-counter change over an observation interval. Existing intended policy blocks are healthy behavior.",
        "source": "https://netfilter.org/projects/nftables/manpage.html",
        "command_ids": [
          "acl_rules",
          "routes"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "KB-RATE",
        "faults": [
          "high_utilization"
        ],
        "title": "Use sustained counter deltas and effective capacity",
        "guidance": "Rates require elapsed time, usable consecutive counters and reset handling. Virtual NIC speed is not a validated bottleneck capacity. Inspect the configured shaping and repeat measurements before interpreting a high percentage.",
        "source": "https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2863",
        "command_ids": [
          "link_counters",
          "traffic_control"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "KB-MISSING",
        "faults": [
          "interface_shutdown",
          "ospf_loss",
